properties.site-address: Town Hall, The Boulevard, Northgate, Crawley
properties.notes: Hybrid planning application CR/2017/0997/OUT for a replacement of town hall, offices and residential development comprising of 182 units is has been granted outline consent (incorporating full permission for the town hall/offices/square element). A district energy centre to serve this development has been approved under planning permission CR/2018/0139/FUL. The site is part of 'Land North of the Boulevard', which is allocated in Local Plan Policies EC6 (Development Sites within the Town Centre Boundary) and H2 (Key Housing Sites) as a 'Town Centre Opportunity Site' for residential development and/or main town centre uses. Policies TC3 and H2 of the Regulation 19 draft Local Plan Review document propose the retention of this allocation..
